description: Physics puzzle destroyer! Launch Blaze from the launcher — his heat melts ice blocks instantly, but rock blocks need hard hits. Knock every crystal orb off its perch across 5 levels. Features combo multipliers, screen-shake, and particle bursts.
fireSafetyLesson: Hot things melt ice and burn skin! Never touch stoves, ovens, or hot pans.
title: Thermal Tug-of-War

description: Vertical arcade runner! Bounce Ruko ever higher — tilt or drag to steer, land on platforms. Green platforms bounce high, cracked ones break! Grab stars for combos. Features screen-shake on spring bounces and particle trails.
fireSafetyLesson: Climb UP to safety! In a fire, never use elevators — take the stairs.
title: Blaze's Jump Quest

description: Top-down arena bumper! Dash around the arena and bump smoke puffs out. Tap a direction to dash — chain bumps for combos. Features screen-shake on impacts, combo multipliers, and particle explosions.
fireSafetyLesson: Smoke rises! If there's smoke, stay LOW where the air is cleaner.
title: Ruko's Dash Blitz

description: Rhythm tap-timing defense! Notes fall down 4 lanes — tap when they hit the line. Perfect timing builds combos; misses damage your rampart wall. Features judgment ratings (PERFECT/GREAT/GOOD), combo multipliers, and screen-shake on misses.
fireSafetyLesson: Defend your home! Make sure smoke alarms work — test them monthly.
title: Boulder's Rampart

description: Endless hopper! Hold to glide, release to drop. Soar through wind rings for boosts and combos. Dodge storm clouds. Features smooth glide physics, combo multipliers on ring chains, and particle trails.
fireSafetyLesson: Wind spreads fire fast! On windy days, be extra careful around anything hot.
title: Cinder's Glide

description: Castle defense ballista aim! Aim and tap to fire water bolts at incoming smoke monsters. Protect the castle across waves — 3 hits and it's over. Features combo multipliers, screen-shake on castle hits, and particle explosions.
fireSafetyLesson: Aim water at the BASE of a fire! That's where the flames feed.
title: Inferno Aim

description: Match-3 with bouncy physics! Tap two adjacent embers to swap. Match 3+ and they pop with physics. 30 moves — chain matches for combo multipliers. Features falling-piece physics, chain reactions, and particle bursts.
fireSafetyLesson: Sparks fly! Keep a safe distance from campfires and fireworks.
title: Spark Jump Arcade

description: Endless dodge & collect! Drag Ruko around the lava moat — collect water shields and stars, dodge falling magma rocks. Grab hearts to heal. Features shield power-ups, combo multipliers, and screen-shake on hits.
fireSafetyLesson: A moat of water stops fire! In real life, close doors to slow fire spread.
title: Lava Moat Defense

description: Physics tug-of-war! Tap YOUR side rapidly to push the magma ball toward the foe's goal. Best of 5 rounds against an AI opponent. Features rope physics, power meters, screen-shake on goals, and particle effects.
fireSafetyLesson: Molten rock is 2000°F! Real volcanoes are beautiful but stay far away.
title: Magma Drop Physics

description: Platformer speedrun! Race to the summit flag — smash through cracked blocks from above. Fastest time wins with best-time tracking. Features smash combos, screen-shake on smashes, and particle debris.
fireSafetyLesson: Volcanoes are dangerous! If one erupts near you, follow evacuation orders immediately.
title: Volcanic Stack Smash

description: Swinging grapple arcade! Tap and hold to shoot your grapple at anchor points, release to fly. Swing past checkpoints — don't hit the ground! Features pendulum physics, checkpoint combos, and particle trails.
fireSafetyLesson: Ropes save lives! Firefighters use ropes and ladders — always have an escape route.
title: Fire Baby Rally

description: Grid strategy tactical! Tap your ember, then tap a highlighted tile to bounce. Capture smoke puffs by landing on them — capture more than the foe AI in 20 turns. Features checkers-style jumps, AI opponent, and capture animations.
fireSafetyLesson: Think ahead! Plan TWO ways out of every room before you need them.
title: Caldera Bounce
